_readme: Mock detection results for sheet A-101, Rev A -> Rev B. Derived from a real comparison of rev_A.pdf and rev_B.pdf. 'box' is the change location as fractions of the image width/height (x0, y0, x1, y1), valid for both rev_A.png and rev_B_aligned.png (Rev B was aligned to Rev A). box = null means the change applies to the whole sheet.

types.label: Design
types.description: Physical change: walls, rooms, openings, fixtures

types.label: Data
types.description: A value changed: area, dimension, label

types.label: Documentation
types.description: Information added to or removed from the sheet, no physical change

types.label: Minor
types.description: Below the significance threshold, or technical. Hidden by default
